text:
Distance from city 1 to city 2: $75$ miles.
Distance from city 2 to city 3: $100$ miles.
Combined distance of the first two legs: $75 + 100 = 175$ miles.
Distance from city 3 to city 1: $175 - 50 = 125$ miles.

Total distance for one complete trip:
$75 + 100 + 125 = 300\text{ miles}$.

The train makes this trip 3 times a day:
$300 \times 3 = 900\text{ miles per day}$.

Days between services (every 18,000 miles):
$18,000 / 900 = 20\text{ days}$.

ANSWER: 20
